notes.title: Joyville Language Update!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to let you know that Joyville is now available in 9 languages: English, German, French, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, and Japanese!

Now most of you can enjoy the game in your native language!

Thanks for sticking with us! Join our Discord server to stay updated on all the important stuff: https://discord.gg/BMSYG8yrS5
